run_single_gpu_test: run a single GPU inference test on a detection model with optional result visualization
run_multi_gpu_test: run a multi-GPU distributed inference test on a detection model with GPU or CPU result collection
test_collect_results_cpu: test the CPU-based result collection across distributed GPU ranks using temporary pickle files
test_collect_results_gpu: test the GPU-based result collection across distributed ranks using torch distributed all_gather
review_single_gpu_test: review the single_gpu_test function to understand visualization and mask encoding logic
